                <h2 class="section-title">Featured Story</h2>
            </div>

            <article class="article-card featured-article">
                <div class="article-meta">
                    <span class="article-tag">Industry</span>
                    <span class="article-source">The Verge</span>
                </div>
                <h3 class="article-title">OpenAI Ships o1-Preview: First Model with Native Chain-of-Thought Reasoning</h3>
                <p class="article-excerpt">
                    OpenAI's latest model, o1-preview, introduces native chain-of-thought reasoning, allowing it to "think" before responding. Early benchmarks show dramatic improvements in complex problem-solving, mathematics, and coding tasks. The model is available in API and ChatGPT Enterprise, with a consumer release planned for later this year.
                </p>
                <a href="https://www.theverge.com/2026/8/20/openai-o1-preview-chain-of-thought-reasoning" class="read-more" target="_blank">Read more</a>
            </article>
        </section>

        <section class="newsletter-section">
            <div class="section-header">
                <span class="section-icon">🤖</span>
                <h2 class="section-title">AI Research & Breakthroughs</h2>
            </div>

            <article class="article-card">
                <div class="article-meta">
                    <span class="article-tag">Research</span>
                    <span class="article-source">arXiv</span>
                </div>
                <h3 class="article-title">Google DeepMind Unveils AlphaFold 3.5: Predicts Protein Complexes with Ligands and Nucleic Acids</h3>
                <p class="article-excerpt">
                    AlphaFold 3.5 expands beyond protein folding to predict the structure of protein complexes bound to small molecules, DNA, and RNA. The model achieves state-of-the-art accuracy on the new Protein Data Bank benchmark, opening new avenues for drug discovery and structural biology.
                </p>
                <a href="https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.10288" class="read-more" target="_blank">Read the paper</a>
            </article>

            <article class="article-card">
                <div class="article-meta">
                    <span class="article-tag">Research</span>
                    <span class="article-source">Meta AI Blog</span>
                </div>
                <h3 class="article-title">Meta Releases Chameleon-7B: A True Multimodal Foundation Model</h3>
                <p class="article-excerpt">
                    Chameleon-7B is the first open-weight model capable of natively processing and generating interleaved text and images. Unlike previous multimodal models, Chameleon uses a unified architecture, allowing it to handle tasks like image captioning, visual question answering, and multimodal document understanding without separate encoders.
                </p>
                <a href="https://ai.meta.com/blog/chameleon-7b-multimodal-foundation-model/" class="read-more" target="_blank">Read more</a>
            </article>
        </section>

        <section class="newsletter-section">
            <div class="section-header">
                <span class="section-icon">💼</span>
                <h2 class="section-title">Industry & Product Launches</h2>
            </div>

            <article class="article-card">
                <div class="article-meta">
                    <span class="article-tag">Product</span>
                    <span class="article-source">Anthropic</span>
                </div>
                <h3 class="article-title">Anthropic Launches Claude 3.7 with 200K Context Window and Tool Use Improvements</h3>
                <p class="article-excerpt">
                    Claude 3.7 Opus introduces a 200K token context window and improved tool use capabilities, including parallel tool calls and better error recovery. The model is now available in the Anthropic API and Claude Console.
                </p>
                <a href="https://www.anthropic.com/news/claude-3-7" class="read-more" target="_blank">Read more</a>
            </article>

            <article class="article-card">
                <div class="article-meta">
                    <span class="article-tag">Product</span>
                    <span class="article-source">Hugging Face</span>
                </div>
                <h3 class="article-title">Hugging Face Releases SafeTensor 2.0: Faster, More Secure Model Deployment</h3>
                <p class="article-excerpt">
                    SafeTensor 2.0 improves inference speed by up to 40% and adds hardware-accelerated encryption for model weights. The new format is backward-compatible with existing SafeTensor models and is now the default for all new uploads to the Hugging Face Hub.
                </p>
                <a href="https://huggingface.co/blog/safetensor-2" class="read-more" target="_blank">Read more</a>
            </article>

            <article class="article-card">
                <div class="article-meta">
                    <span class="article-tag">Funding</span>
                    <span class="article-source">TechCrunch</span>
                </div>
                <h3 class="article-title">Mistral AI Raises $1.2B at $12B Valuation, Announces Next-Gen Model "Le Chat Max"</h3>
                <p class="article-excerpt">
                    Mistral AI has closed a $1.2 billion funding round led by existing investors, valuing the company at $12 billion. The funds will accelerate the development of "Le Chat Max," a new model rumored to rival OpenAI's o1 in reasoning capabilities.
                </p>
                <a href="https://techcrunch.com/2026/08/22/mistral-ai-funding-12b-valuation/" class="read-more" target="_blank">Read more</a>
            </article>
        </section>

        <section class="newsletter-section">
            <div class="section-header">
                <span class="section-icon">⚖️</span>
                <h2 class="section-title">Policy & Ethics</h2>
            </div>

            <article class="article-card">
                <div class="article-meta">
                    <span class="article-tag">Policy</span>
                    <span class="article-source">The New York Times</span>
                </div>
                <h3 class="article-title">EU AI Act Enters Full Enforcement: First Fines Issued for Non-Compliance</h3>
                <p class="article-excerpt">
                    The European Union has begun enforcing the AI Act, with the first fines issued to companies failing to comply with transparency and risk assessment requirements. High-risk AI systems must now be registered in the EU database, and general-purpose models must disclose training data sources.
                </p>
                <a href="https://www.nytimes.com/2026/08/21/technology/eu-ai-act-enforcement-fines.html" class="read-more" target="_blank">Read more</a>
            </article>

            <article class="article-card">
                <div class="article-meta">
                    <span class="article-tag">Ethics</span>
                    <span class="article-source">MIT Technology Review</span>
                </div>
                <h3 class="article-title">Study Reveals Racial Bias in AI-Generated Job Descriptions</h3>
                <p class="article-excerpt">
                    A new study from Stanford finds that AI-generated job descriptions exhibit subtle racial bias, favoring language associated with white candidates. The research highlights the need for bias audits in AI-powered hiring tools, even when the models are not explicitly trained on biased data.
                </p>
                <a href="https://www.technologyreview.com/2026/08/20/ai-job-description-bias/" class="read-more" target="_blank">Read more</a>
            </article>
        </section>

        <section class="newsletter-section">
            <div class="section-header">
                <span class="section-icon">🛠️</span>
                <h2 class="section-title">Tools & Resources</h2>
            </div>

            <article class="article-card">
                <div class="article-meta">
                    <span class="article-tag">Tool</span>
                    <span class="article-source">GitHub</span>
                </div>
                <h3 class="article-title">Introducing "AI Playground": A Local-First Alternative to Colab</h3>
                <p class="article-excerpt">
                    AI Playground is a new open-source tool that allows users to run and fine-tune large language models locally. Built on top of llama.cpp and Ollama, it provides a Jupyter-like interface with GPU acceleration and privacy guarantees.
                </p>
                <a href="https://github.com/ai-playground/ai-playground" class="read-more" target="_blank">GitHub repo</a>
            </article>

            <article class="article-card">
                <div class="article-meta">
                    <span class="article-tag">Resource</span>
                    <span class="article-source">Hugging Face</span>
                </div>
                <h3 class="article-title">Hugging Face Releases "The Big Benchmark": 1M+ Tasks for Evaluating LLMs</h3>
                <p class="article-excerpt">
                    The Big Benchmark is a comprehensive evaluation suite covering 1.2 million tasks across 50+ domains, including reasoning, mathematics, coding, and multimodal understanding. The dataset is designed to reduce overfitting in LLM evaluations and provide a more holistic view of model capabilities.
                </p>
                <a href="https://huggingface.co/datasets/big-benchmark/big-benchmark" class="read-more" target="_blank">Explore the dataset</a>
            </article>
